{"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions treats both as local. v2 rows from the local evening land 6 hours late: after midnight, or on the next date (hence the 41 rows on 01-19 and the 00:00-06:00 alerts). Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago time before deriving txn_date fixes it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
         customer_id,
         CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
         CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
         CASE WHEN collector = 'v2'
              THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP)
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts,
       CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM base;"}}
